Package com.spaceinvaders.backend.auth.utils

Class ServerInfo

java.lang.Object
com.spaceinvaders.backend.auth.utils.ServerInfo
public class ServerInfo extends Object
ServerInfo.java
The ServerInfo class tells the client where the game server is. The server used to publish its address to a Firebase Realtime Database; now the address is configured locally, in order of precedence:
  1. the nebula.server system property (Gradle: ./gradlew lwjgl3:run -Pserver=192.168.1.20)
  2. the NEBULA_SERVER environment variable
  3. 127.0.0.1, i.e. a server on this machine
The HTTP port can be overridden the same way with nebula.httpPort / NEBULA_HTTP_PORT.
Since:
11/27/2024
